Unit condition: >= 3,000 and < 5,200 units -> Demand follow-up queue activation level
Unit condition: < 1,500 units from a decision threshold -> Manual merchandising verification variance band
Unit condition: >= 20,000 and < 35,000 units -> Expanded replenishment planning level
Unit condition: >= 35,000 units -> Growth allocation review level
